findings.claim: Collector rejects types with no declaring syntax (metadata-only) in GeneratedFormatterCollector, yet the requirement's whole point is T in a referenced assembly. `type.DeclaringSyntaxReferences.IsEmpty` is true for any type from a referenced assembly (incl. ExternalPerson), so MsgPack021 would be reported and no formatter generated; this contradicts the requirement. Note L11 says metadata types are deliberately not formatted by default analysis, but the explicit attribute is the opt-in the requirement asks for, so L11 does not excuse this.

receipt_plan.detail: Run GeneratedFormatterForExternalTypesTests (ExecutionTests references ExternalTypes assembly): ExternalPerson formatter should fail to generate / MsgPack021 reported because DeclaringSyntaxReferences is empty for metadata types.

findings.claim: Contractless mode skips public read-only members and surrogate matching requires read-write; this deviates from the maintainer's contractless semantic (public members), though ledger L19 says no preference/follow the requirement. The README documents this, so it is recorded and acceptable.

receipt_plan.detail: [L19] no preference; follow the requirement; [L18] contractless default plus optional SurrogateType accepted.

findings.claim: Requirement says if T carries MessagePack attributes (e.g. [DataContract], [MessagePackObject], [Key]) they are honoured; the collector ignores attributes on T entirely and always uses contractless or surrogate. Acceptance criterion unmet.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a generator test where T has [MessagePackObject] with [Key(0)] int keys on a property and a [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] class; assert the generated formatter uses int keys, which will fail since contractless string keys are used.

findings.claim: The new GeneratedMessagePackFormatter attribute is documented and diagnostics MsgPack019-022 are added to release notes and docs, so conventions are followed; however no generator snapshot tests cover successful generation output for the new formatter.

receipt_plan.detail: Rerun generator snapshot tests; no snapshot exists for a [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] success case.

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: Implements contractless-by-default plus an optional SurrogateType property on the attribute (surrogate keys by name), ignoring MessagePack attributes on T.

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: Contractless-only core: no SurrogateType; honour [DataContract]/[MessagePackObject]/[Key] attributes already on T when present, falling back to contractless when absent.
